scenarios.name: sequence_after_1000_restart
scenarios.feature: AUTO_INCREMENT and BIGSERIAL continuation after 1000 rows and a node restart
scenarios.risk: sequence durability across a node restart on the persisted registry

scenarios.external: real engine restart evidence: MySQL 8.0.44 and PostgreSQL 16.15 continued at 1001 after a restart
